name: Garden Vegetable Pasta
tagline: Tender penne tossed with roasted vegetables and fresh fragrant basil.
description: A vibrant Mediterranean pasta dish loaded with crisp zucchini, colorful bell peppers, blistered cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil. Perfect for a quick, comforting weeknight dinner.

steps.title: Wash & Chop Vegetables
steps.instruction: Rinse the zucchini, bell peppers, and cherry tomatoes thoroughly. Dice the zucchini and peppers into bite-sized pieces and slice cherry tomatoes in halves.

steps.title: Boil Pasta in Salted Water
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rapid boil. Cook penne pasta for 9-11 minutes until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Sauté Garlic & Aromatics
steps.instruction: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant and golden.

steps.title: Cook the Vegetables
steps.instruction: Add the diced zucchini and bell peppers to the skillet. Cook for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp, then fold in cherry tomatoes until they begin to burst.

steps.title: Toss Pasta with Sauce
steps.instruction: Add drained pasta and 1/4 cup reserved pasta water into the skillet. Season with salt, freshly cracked black pepper, and chili flakes. Toss vigorously to emulsify.

steps.title: Garnish & Serve Fresh
steps.instruction: Remove skillet from heat. Fold in torn fresh basil leaves and freshly shaved parmesan cheese. Drizzle with finishing olive oil and enjoy!

chefTip: Always salt your pasta cooking water until it tastes like mild seawater—it seasons the pasta from the inside out.

name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
tagline: Velvety roasted tomatoes with aromatic herbs and a touch of cream.
description: Rich, comforting soup made from oven-roasted vine tomatoes, caramelized onions, garlic, and sweet basil leaves. Pureed to velvety perfection and served with rustic bread.

steps.title: Prep Tomatoes & Garlic
steps.instruction: Halve the ripe vine tomatoes and slice onion. Cut the top off a whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Place everything on a baking tray.

steps.title: Roast until Caramelized
steps.instruction: Drizzle with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until tomatoes are blistered and edges are caramelized.

steps.title: Blend Roasted Veggies
steps.instruction: Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves out of their skins. Transfer roasted tomatoes, onions, garlic, and fresh basil leaves into a blender.

steps.title: Simmer with Broth
steps.instruction: Pour the smooth puree into a pot. Stir in vegetable broth and simmer gently for 8-10 minutes to deepen flavors.

steps.title: Swirl Cream & Serve
steps.instruction: Lower the flame and stir in fresh cream. Ladle into warm bowls, drizzle with olive oil, and serve with toasted crusty sourdough.

chefTip: Roasting the garlic whole in its skin turns the cloves sweet and buttery without any bitter sharpness.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
tagline: Tender paneer cubes swimming in a rich, buttery spiced tomato gravy.
description: An iconic North Indian restaurant favorite! Soft cubes of Indian cottage cheese simmered in a luscious, mildly sweet, and aromatic tomato-cashew sauce finished with kasuri methi and butter.

steps.title: Soak Cashews & Cube Paneer
steps.instruction: Soak cashews in hot water for 15 minutes. Cut fresh paneer into uniform 1-inch cubes and soak in warm water to keep them soft.

steps.title: Make Tomato-Cashew Puree
steps.instruction: Boil tomatoes and soaked cashews for 6 minutes. Cool slightly and blend into a silk-smooth puree. Strain through a fine sieve.

steps.title: Sauté Aromatics in Butter
steps.instruction: Melt butter with a dash of oil in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook Gravy with Spices
steps.instruction: Pour in the strained tomato puree. Add Kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook on low heat until butter releases from sides.

steps.title: Add Paneer & Cream
steps.instruction: Gently fold in the paneer cubes. Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 3 minutes on low heat so the paneer absorbs the sauce.

steps.title: Crush Kasuri Methi & Serve
steps.instruction: Crush dry kasuri methi between your palms and sprinkle on top with garam masala. Garnish with a swirl of cream and serve with naan.

chefTip: Keep the flame on very low when adding cream to prevent curdling and maintain a velvety sheen.

name: Crispy Masala Dosa
tagline: Golden paper-thin fermented crepe stuffed with spiced potato masala.
description: Authentic South Indian classic! Ultra-crisp golden fermented rice-lentil crepes filled with a warm spiced turmeric potato mash, served alongside coconut chutney and piping hot sambar.

steps.title: Prepare Potato Masala
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Splutter mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies. Sauté sliced onions until soft and translucent.

steps.title: Season & Mash Potatoes
steps.instruction: Add turmeric, salt, and 1/4 cup water. Fold in boiled roughly mashed potatoes. Mix thoroughly until yellow, warm, and moist.

steps.title: Heat & Season Cast Iron Tawa
steps.instruction: Heat a heavy cast iron or non-stick tawa until smoking hot. Splash a few drops of water to cool slightly and wipe clean.

steps.title: Spread Batter in Concentric Circles
steps.instruction: Pour a ladleful of dosa batter in the center. Using the back of the ladle, quickly spiral outwards into a thin, even circle.

steps.title: Drizzle Ghee & Cook Crisp
steps.instruction: Drizzle a teaspoon of ghee around the edges and center. Cook on medium-high heat until the underside turns rich golden brown.

steps.title: Fill with Potato Masala & Roll
steps.instruction: Place 3 tablespoons of warm potato masala across the center. Fold over into a neat cylinder and serve hot with chutney.

chefTip: Wiping the tawa with a damp cloth or onion slice between dosas maintains the ideal temperature for spreading thin batter.

name: Classic Vegetable Fried Rice
tagline: Wok-seared fragrant rice with colorful crisp vegetables and sesame oil.
description: High-heat wok tossed jasmine rice loaded with sweet green peas, crunchy carrots, tender corn kernels, spring onions, and a splash of soy sauce. Fast, savory, and satisfying.

steps.title: Prep Day-Old Cold Rice
steps.instruction: Use cold, day-old cooked rice. Gently separate the grains with damp hands so there are no large clumps.

steps.title: Dice Veggies & Aromatics
steps.instruction: Finely dice carrots, mince garlic, and slice spring onions, separating the white parts from the green garnish.

steps.title: Sear Aromatics in Smoking Wok
steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry minced garlic and spring onion whites for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Stir-Fry Crisp Vegetables
steps.instruction: Toss in the diced carrots, peas, and sweetcorn. Stir-fry rapidly on high heat for 3 minutes to keep them crisp and vibrant.

steps.title: Toss in Rice & Sauces
steps.instruction: Add the cold rice into the wok. Drizzle soy sauce around the perimeter of the wok and toss vigorously for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with Sesame Oil & Scallions
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat. Drizzle toasted sesame oil and scatter spring onion greens. Toss one final time and serve hot.

chefTip: Day-old cold rice has less surface moisture, preventing the rice from becoming gummy or mushy in the wok.

name: Homestyle Chickpea Curry (Chana)
tagline: Wholesome chickpeas simmered in an earthy ginger-tomato masala.
description: A protein-packed North Indian staple! Plump garbanzo beans simmered in a spiced tomato, onion, and pomegranate reduction with ginger matchsticks and cilantro.

steps.title: Sauté Cumin & Onions
steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a deep pot. Crackle cumin seeds, then add chopped onions and sauté for 8 minutes until deep golden brown.

steps.title: Add Ginger-Garlic & Tomato Puree
steps.instruction: Stir in ginger paste, garlic, and tomato puree. Cook for 6 minutes until the oil starts separating from the masala base.

steps.title: Incorporate Spices
steps.instruction: Add chana masala powder, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Sauté for 1 minute to release aromatic essential oils.

steps.title: Simmer Chickpeas & Mash a Few
steps.instruction: Add cooked chickpeas and 1.5 cups water. Lightly mash 2 tablespoons of chickpeas with the back of a ladle to thicken the gravy.

steps.title: Gently Simmer for Rich Gravy
steps.instruction: Cover and simmer on low heat for 12 minutes so the chickpeas absorb all the spices.

steps.title: Garnish with Ginger & Lemon
steps.instruction: Uncover, stir in fresh lemon juice, top with ginger juliennes and chopped cilantro. Serve warm with fluffy basmati rice.

chefTip: Mashing just a few chickpeas directly in the pot creates a naturally thick and luscious gravy without cornstarch.

name: Crisp Garden Green Salad
tagline: Refreshing seasonal greens with shaved radishes and zesty herb vinaigrette.
description: Crisp romaine lettuce, peppery radishes, sweet cherry tomatoes, and English cucumbers tossed in a bright, zesty lemon-dijon vinaigrette. The ultimate clean, vibrant starter.

steps.title: Wash & Spin Greens
steps.instruction: Rinse romaine lettuce in cold water. Spin completely dry in a salad spinner so dressing adheres perfectly.

steps.title: Slice Vegetables Uniformly
steps.instruction: Thinly slice English cucumbers and radishes. Slice sweet cherry tomatoes into halves.

steps.title: Whisk Zesty Vinaigrette
steps.instruction: In a small glass jar, vigorously whisk olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and black pepper until emulsified.

steps.title: Toss Gently in Wooden Bowl
steps.instruction: Place crisp greens and vegetables into a wide bowl. Drizzle vinaigrette and toss gently with salad hands just before serving.

chefTip: Make sure salad leaves are completely dry before dressing; excess water dilutes the vinaigrette and causes sogginess.

name: Creamy Wild Mushroom Fettuccine
tagline: Silky tagliatelle with sautéed shiitake and cremini in garlic parmesan sauce.
description: Earthy, velvety comfort in every bite. Sautéed wild mushrooms and garlic deglazed with vegetable reduction, tossed with ribbons of fettuccine in a parmesan cream sauce.

steps.title: Cook Fettuccine Al Dente
steps.instruction: Cook fettuccine in boiling salted water for 10 minutes until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking liquid, then drain.

steps.title: Brown the Mushrooms
steps.instruction: Heat butter and olive oil in a wide skillet over high heat. Add sliced mushrooms in a single layer and sear undisturbed for 4 minutes until deeply golden.

steps.title: Add Garlic & Fresh Thyme
steps.instruction: Stir in sliced garlic and fresh thyme leaves. Sauté for 1-2 minutes until aromatic without letting garlic burn.

steps.title: Simmer Cream & Parmesan
steps.instruction: Pour in heavy cream and a splash of pasta water. Bring to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes, then stir in grated parmesan cheese.

steps.title: Toss Fettuccine to Glaze
steps.instruction: Toss the fettuccine ribbons directly into the sauce. Toss continuously for 2 minutes until the sauce clings to every strand.

chefTip: Don't salt mushrooms immediately when putting them in the pan; let them sear first so they brown instead of steaming.

name: Fluffy Golden Buttermilk Pancakes
tagline: Pillowy stack of buttermilk hotcakes with melting butter and maple syrup.
description: Light, airy, melt-in-your-mouth breakfast pancakes made with buttermilk and real vanilla. Cooked to a golden brown ring and stacked high with berries and warm maple syrup.

steps.title: Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instruction: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and fine sea salt until evenly aerated.

steps.title: Mix Wet Ingredients
steps.instruction: In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract until smooth and frothy.

steps.title: Fold Gently & Rest Batter
steps.instruction: Pour wet ingredients into dry. Fold gently with a spatula just until combined—a few small lumps are good! Rest batter for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook until Bubbles Form
steps.instruction: Heat a buttered griddle over medium heat. Ladle 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles surface and pop.

steps.title: Flip & Golden Finish
steps.instruction: Flip gently and cook the other side for 1-2 minutes until puffed and golden brown. Stack and top with butter and maple syrup.

chefTip: Do not overmix pancake batter! Leaving small flour pockets creates steam during cooking, producing the fluffiest texture.

name: Fudgy Double Chocolate Brownies
tagline: Decadent dark chocolate squares with crackly tops and gooey centers.
description: Rich, fudgy chocolate perfection! Made with melted bittersweet chocolate, pure cocoa powder, and semi-sweet chocolate chunks for a glorious molten bite with signature crinkly tops.

steps.title: Melt Chocolate & Butter
steps.instruction: Melt chopped dark chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl set over simmering water until glossy and smooth.

steps.title: Whip Eggs & Sugar until Ribbons
steps.instruction: In a stand mixer, vigorously whip eggs and sugar for 5 minutes until pale, frothy, and doubled in volume.

steps.title: Fold in Chocolate & Dry Ingredients
steps.instruction: Gently fold melted chocolate into the egg mixture. Sift in flour, cocoa powder, and salt. Fold in chocolate chunks.

steps.title: Bake in Lined Pan
steps.instruction: Spread batter into an 8x8 inch parchment-lined baking tin. Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 25-28 minutes until center is just set.

steps.title: Cool & Slice into Squares
steps.instruction: Allow to cool completely in the pan for 45 minutes to set the fudgy texture, then slice into neat squares with a warm knife.

chefTip: Whipping the eggs and sugar until pale and frothy is the secret to getting that coveted glossy, paper-thin crinkly brownie crust!

name: Royal Vegetable Dum Biryani
tagline: Fragrant saffron basmati rice layered with spiced garden vegetables.
description: An imperial celebration feast! Long-grain aged basmati rice layered with spiced cauliflower, carrots, beans, and potatoes, sealed in a pot (dum) with saffron milk, mint, and fried onions.

ingredients.name: Biryani whole spices (cardamom, clove, star anise)

steps.title: Parboil Aged Basmati Rice
steps.instruction: Boil soaked basmati rice with whole spices (cloves, cardamom, bay leaf) for 6 minutes until 70% cooked. Drain and spread out to cool.

steps.title: Marinate Garden Vegetables
steps.instruction: Marinate diced vegetables in thick yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, red chili powder, and salt for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cook Spiced Vegetable Gravy
steps.instruction: Heat ghee in a heavy pot. Cook the marinated vegetables for 8-10 minutes until half tender and gravy is rich and fragrant.

steps.title: Layer Rice, Saffron & Herbs
steps.instruction: Layer the parboiled rice over the vegetable masala. Top with golden fried onions, fresh mint leaves, cilantro, and saffron milk.

steps.title: Dum Cook on Gentle Flame
steps.instruction: Seal pot tightly with a lid or dough. Cook on high for 3 minutes, then transfer to a heavy tawa on low heat for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Gently Fluff & Serve with Raita
steps.instruction: Rest for 10 minutes, then uncover and gently fluff from bottom to top with a flat spatula. Serve with cool cucumber raita.

chefTip: Parboil the rice to exactly 70%—when broken between fingers, it should split into 3 pieces without being mushy.

name: Lemon Rosemary Grilled Chicken
tagline: Herb-marinated chicken breast seared with charred lemon and asparagus.
description: Tender, juicy chicken breasts marinated in fresh lemon juice, crushed garlic, rosemary, and olive oil. Seared to golden perfection with grill marks and served alongside tender asparagus.

steps.title: Pound Chicken to Even Thickness
steps.instruction: Place chicken breasts between parchment paper and pound lightly with a rolling pin to uniform 1/2-inch thickness for even grilling.

steps.title: Marinate in Citrus & Herbs
steps.instruction: Whisk olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, crushed garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper. Coat chicken and marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat Grill Pan to High
steps.instruction: Heat a ridged cast-iron grill pan over medium-high heat until lightly smoking. Brush lightly with olive oil.

steps.title: Grill Chicken undisturbed
steps.instruction: Place chicken breasts on the grill pan. Grill undisturbed for 5-6 minutes until deep golden grill marks develop.

steps.title: Flip & Sear Veggies
steps.instruction: Flip chicken and cook for another 4-5 minutes until internal temp reaches 74°C (165°F). Add asparagus and tomatoes alongside.

steps.title: Rest & Carve into Slices
steps.instruction: Transfer chicken to a board and let rest for 5 minutes so juices redistribute. Carve into angled slices and serve with charred lemon.

chefTip: Pounding the chicken to an even thickness prevents the tapered ends from drying out while waiting for the center to cook.
